Definition: a fissure, i.e. (concretely) firstling (as opening the matrix)
BiblicalUsage: Peter is the firstling, whatever opens the womb first, and God claims it as His own. At the Exodus He commands Israel to sanctify every firstborn of man and beast, and later He takes the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the firstling law teaches me the first belongs to God: what opens the womb is His, and He gave the Levites to stand in its place.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
